content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text assigns a verdict of UNDERDETERMINED to a point and gives a reason, so it is the kind of ground the rule governs.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.", "room": "The phrase 'immediately qualified by the child's reference' could be read as a single-verse test (Luke 2:49 must state the contrary), or as an observation about how the two verses work together in the chain. I weighed both readings.", "why": "The stated reason does not say that no single verse states a link or its contrary; it rests on how Luke 2:48 and 2:49 qualify each other and on the defender's rounds, so the forbidden ground is not used."}
